answer: A decentralized network of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to a cryptographically verifiable proof of physical resource expenditure, akin to burning a scarce digital crystal. This economic friction makes mass-identity spoofing mathematically and financially unsustainable.
